wav2vec2_base.notes: Frozen Stage 5E primary result. Retained verbatim.

whisper_base.notes: Autoregressive seq2seq model without CTC frame emissions. Frame entropy SUTA mathematically undefined. Static No-Adapt evaluated.

data2vec_base.notes: Data2Vec Audio CTC model. Full CTC frame logits + LayerNorms.

distil_whisper_small.notes: Distilled seq2seq model without CTC frame emissions. Frame entropy SUTA mathematically undefined. Static No-Adapt evaluated.

xlsr_english.notes: Cross-lingual 53-language pretrained encoder fine-tuned on English. Full CTC frame logits + LayerNorms.

hubert_large.role: Self-supervised encoder comparison (Acoustic Cluster SSL, Large-960h FT)
hubert_large.notes: Official Fairseq CTC ASR release of the HuBERT family (HubertForCTC, 316.8M params). Full CTC frame logits + LayerNorms.
